The local intelligence company.

Lyzr is a private agent infrastructure platform that runs fully air-gapped on-prem or in your own VPC, so enterprises can build and manage their intelligence locally.

Trusted by Accenture, Crown Castle, WTW, Verifone, KPMG, AWS, Hitachi, Movate, Firstsource, MSP Corp, Persistent and AirAsia Move.
